originalTitle: Paper Tiger - Official Teaser Trailer - In Theaters November
content: In James Gray’s deeply felt and intense drama, two brothers become entangled in a scheme that turns out to be too good to be true. As they try to navigate their way through the dangerous world of the Russian mafia, family bonds begin to fray with life-altering consequences.
chineseContent: 在詹姆斯·格雷感人至深、激烈的戏剧中，两兄弟卷入了一个好得令人难以置信的计划。当他们试图穿越俄罗斯黑手党的危险世界时，家庭纽带开始出现冲突，并带来了改变生活的后果。
